an5.157:1.1: pañcannaṃ bhikkhave puggalānaṃ kathā dukkathā puggale puggalaṃ upanidhāya
an5.157:2.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave assaddhassa saddhākathā dukkathā
an5.157:2.2: assaddho bhikkhave saddhākathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:2.4: tañhi so bhikkhave saddhāsampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:3.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave dussīlassa sīlakathā dukkathā
an5.157:3.2: dussīlo bhikkhave sīlakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:3.4: tañhi so bhikkhave sīlasampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:4.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave appassutassa bāhusaccakathā dukkathā
an5.157:4.2: appassuto bhikkhave bāhusaccakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:4.4: tañhi so bhikkhave sutasampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:5.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave maccharissa cāgakathā dukkathā
an5.157:5.2: maccharī bhikkhave cāgakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:5.4: tañhi so bhikkhave cāgasampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:6.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave duppaññassa paññākathā dukkathā
an5.157:6.2: duppañño bhikkhave paññākathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:6.4: tañhi so bhikkhave paññāsampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:6.6: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ puggalānaṃ kathā dukkathā puggale puggalaṃ upanidhāya.
an5.157:7.1: pañcannaṃ bhikkhave puggalānaṃ kathā sukathā puggale puggalaṃ upanidhāya
an5.157:8.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave saddhassa saddhākathā sukathā
an5.157:8.2: saddho bhikkhave saddhākathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na byāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:8.4: tañhi so bhikkhave saddhāsampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:9.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave sīlavato sīlakathā sukathā
an5.157:9.2: sīlavā bhikkhave sīlakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na byāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:9.4: tañhi so bhikkhave sīlasampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:10.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave bahussutassa bāhusaccakathā sukathā
an5.157:10.2: bahussuto bhikkhave bāhusaccakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na byāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:10.4: tañhi so bhikkhave sutasampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:11.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave cāgavato cāgakathā sukathā
an5.157:11.2: cāgavā bhikkhave cāgakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na byāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:11.4: tañhi so bhikkhave cāgasampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:12.1: kasmā ca bhikkhave paññavato paññākathā sukathā
an5.157:12.2: paññavā bhikkhave paññākathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na byāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an5.157:12.4: tañhi so bhikkhave paññāsampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tatonidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ
an5.157:12.6: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ puggalānaṃ kathā sukathā puggale puggalaṃ upanidhāyāti.
